item.title: bo-1: atm-bd-core layout and installer destinations

results.statement: Every Python file and extensionless Python script in the plugin and the console must be inside the pyright include and pass pyright in just lint and CI.
results.deterministic_check: a test walks the tree for *.py files and python-shebang scripts and asserts each is matched by the pyrightconfig include; just lint runs pyright at 0 errors

results.statement: Lite-only scripts must live in skills/atm-bd-lite/scripts and lite-only templates in skills/atm-bd-lite/templates; full-only ones live relative to the atm-bd-orchestration skill.
results.quote: i would expect the atm-bd-lite only scripts to be in skills/atm-bd-lite/scripts/  and templates in atm-bd-lite/templates/ w/ corresponding atm-bd-orchestration scripts/stemplates located relative to the skill.
results.deterministic_check: every file under skills/atm-bd-lite/scripts and templates is imported or rendered only by lite; core/ holds nothing lite-only
results.explanation: Structural anchor: verified by its deterministic_check, not by Jev

results.statement: Shared scripts and templates must live at one common point, .atm-bd/scripts and .atm-bd/templates at the repository root, removing the duplicates under .claude, .codex and .agents.
results.quote: scripts/templates would be at a common point (which perhaps would best be at repo root in .atm-bd/scripts and /templates.  That would remove duplicates across .claude/ .codex/ and .agents/ that exist today
results.deterministic_check: after atm-bd skill install, each shared module exists once under .atm-bd and diff finds no copy under .claude, .codex or .agents
results.explanation: Structural anchor: verified by its deterministic_check, not by Jev
